question:
Study the given bar graph and answer the question that follows.

The bar graph shows the exports of cars of type A and B (in Rs. millions) from 2014 to 2018. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bef659ed515013874864fbc8ab975a25a315df07818be86a4d524d73ae95b3c9.png] 

What is the ratio of the total exports of cars of type A in 2016 and 2018 to the total exports of cars of type B in 2014 and 2017?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Number of exports of cars of type A in 2016 = 275

Number of exports of cars of type A in 2018 = 300

Total numbers of exports of cars of type A in 2016 and 2018 = 275 + 300

⇒ 575&l
